# Italy Review

> Comprehensive travel guide to Italy covering major cities like Rome, Venice, Florence, Milan, and Naples, plus regional destinations across Tuscany, Puglia, Sardinia, and beyond.

Italy Review provides detailed travel guides for Italian destinations including beaches, lakes, historic towns, religious architecture, and cultural landmarks. Coverage spans all regions from the Dolomites to Sicily, with particular focus on lesser-known gems alongside iconic cities.

## Key Topics

- Rome
- Venice
- Florence
- Milan
- Naples
- Tuscany
- Sardinia
- Puglia
- Lake Como
- Italian beaches
- South Sardinia
- Religious architecture
- Beach destinations
- Historic hill towns
- Italian lakes

## Major Regions

- [Calabria](https://www.italyreview.com/calabria.html): Calabria region overview with sea and mountains in southern Italy
- [Sassari Province • Northern Sardinia](https://www.italyreview.com/sassari-province.html): Sassari Province overview with 92 communes in Northern Sardinia
- [Metropolitan City of Cagliari • Sardinia • Province](https://www.italyreview.com/metropolitan-city-of-cagliari.html): Metropolitan City of Cagliari province with regional capital

## Beach Destinations

- [Cala Cipolla • South Sardinia • Beach](https://www.italyreview.com/cala-cipolla.html): Cala Cipolla beach guide near Chia with granite rocks and clear water
- [Cala Domestica • South Sardinia • Beach](https://www.italyreview.com/cala-domestica.html): Cala Domestica beach in South Sardinia with mining heritage and cliffs
- [Pugnochiuso • Puglia • Gargano Peninsula • Beach](https://www.italyreview.com/pugnochiuso.html): Pugnochiuso beach on Gargano Peninsula near Vieste in Puglia
- [Visit Borghetto Santo Spirito – Beach Resort in Liguria](https://www.italyreview.com/borghetto-santo-spirito.html): Borghetto Santo Spirito beach resort on Liguria's Riviera di Ponente
- [Sampieri Travel Guide – Plan Your Visit to the Beach Resort in Sicily](https://www.italyreview.com/sampieri.html): Sampieri seaside resort in Sicily with Pisciotto brickworks ruins
- [Holiday Marinas of Sardinia](https://www.italyreview.com/holiday-marinas-of-sardinia.html): Costa Smeralda holiday marinas on Sardinia's northeast coast

## Lakes & Alpine Destinations

- [Lake Carezza • Karersee • South Tyrol • Dolomites](https://www.italyreview.com/lake-carezza.html): Lake Carezza (Karersee) alpine lake in South Tyrol Dolomites
- [Lake Barrea • Abruzzo • Central Italy](https://www.italyreview.com/lake-barrea.html): Lake Barrea travel guide in Abruzzo's Province of l'Aquila
- [Visit Abbadia Lariana – Lakeside Village on Lake Como](https://www.italyreview.com/abbadia-lariana.html): Abbadia Lariana lakeside village on Lake Como with hiking trails
- [Visit Isola Maggiore – island on Lake Trasimeno](https://www.italyreview.com/isola-maggiore.html): Isola Maggiore island on Lake Trasimeno with ferries and churches

## Religious Architecture & Churches

- [Basilica di Santa Maria Novella](https://www.italyreview.com/basilica-di-santa-maria-novella.html): Basilica di Santa Maria Novella in Florence with Alberti façade
- [Turin Cathedral](https://www.italyreview.com/turin-cathedral.html): Turin Cathedral Renaissance church housing the Turin Shroud
- [Sacro Monte di Domodossola](https://www.italyreview.com/sacro-monte-di-domodossola.html): Sacro Monte di Domodossola UNESCO religious sanctuary in Piedmont
- [Volterra Baptistery](https://www.italyreview.com/volterra-baptistery.html): Battistero di San Giovanni octagonal baptistery opposite Volterra Cathedral

## Historic Towns & Villages

- [Visit Cori – Historic Hill Town in Lazio](https://www.italyreview.com/cori.html): Cori hill town in Lazio with ancient polygonal walls and temples
- [Visit Capalbio – Medieval Coastal Village in Tuscany](https://www.italyreview.com/capalbio.html): Capalbio medieval village in southern Tuscany with Aldobrandeschi fortress
